title: Gods World — Meet Maxi, robotic AI with true imagination
description: Maxi builds a scene, changes it, runs it forward, watches what happens and learns from what it watched. Talk to Maxi and watch its imagination.

hero.h1_html: Meet Maxi, robotic AI with true imagination.
hero.lede: Maxi runs the future before it acts. Give it a scene, let it change something, and watch what it sees, inside the physics engine that doesn't know any physics equations. You talk on one side of the screen; its imagination is on the other.
hero.kicker_html: Every stage runs today. Build, intervene, run the counterfactual, see, learn: say "put light in the scene and let light do what light does" and see what it sees.

art.alt: Maxi's imagination: a three-dimensional double-slit experiment, the detector wall painting its own interference pattern hit by hit
